style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: The one who sees the supreme equally among beings, imperishable amid the perishing, truly sees
candidates.evidence: यः पश्यति स पश्यति (who sees, he sees)

candidates.angle: The one who sees the supreme being equally present in all beings, imperishable amid the perishing, truly sees
The one who sees the supreme being equally present in all beings, imperishable amid the perishing, truly sees
candidates.evidence: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु (equally in all beings)

en.intro: Krishna shifts the lesson from the battlefield to the nature of reality, and asks Arjuna to look past the dying bodies to the one presence within them.
en.notice: The word avinashyantam means imperishable, and Krishna sets it against vinashyatsu, the perishing. He says the supreme being is unperishing among the perishing, and the one who sees this truly sees.
en.next: Seeing the divine equally everywhere, a person does not wound the true self by the true self, and reaches the highest state.
en.meaning: One who sees the supreme being equally present in all beings, imperishable amid the perishing, truly sees.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अब युद्ध के मैदान से हटकर वास्तविकता की ओर ध्यान दिलाते हैं, और अर्जुन से कहते हैं कि वे मरते हुए शरीरों के पार एक उपस्थिति को देखें।
hi.meaning: जो नष्ट होते हुए सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें परमात्माको नाशरहित और समरूपसे स्थित देखता है, वही वास्तवमें सही देखता है ॥
hi.next: दिव्य को सर्वत्र समान रूप से देखकर, व्यक्ति अपने वास्तविक स्वरूप को अपने ही स्वरूप से आहत नहीं करता, और सर्वोच्च अवस्था को प्राप्त करता है।
